entities.name: Adia
entities.description: A young Zhalfirin acolyte of the Civic Creed, a healer and caretaker orphaned in the Keldon War.

entities.name: Civic Creed
entities.description: A Zhalfirin order whose acolytes dress in plain white robes and serve their community.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Returns to the village and is called to mobilize for war.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The nation Adia fears may become defined only by war.

entities.name: Kipamu
entities.description: Place from which soldiers came looking for Teferi.

entities.name: Keldon War
entities.description: War in which Adia was orphaned.

events.summary: Adia joins the Civic Creed after being orphaned in the Keldon War.
events.quote: Adia joined the Civic Creed after she was orphaned in the Keldon War

events.summary: Adia meets Teferi on his return and tells him soldiers from Kipamu want him to mobilize for the war.
events.quote: She informed him that soldiers from Kipamu had been looking for him regarding the war

events.summary: Adia voices fears about the cost of war and Zhalfir becoming defined only by its military engagements.
events.quote: Adia expressed deep concerns about the onset of war

events.summary: Adia gives Teferi mended robes and bids him a worried farewell as he leaves with the soldiers.
events.quote: She presented Teferi with mended robes

relations.quote: Adia is a Zhalfirin acolyte of the Civic Creed .
